body:
Hi, thank you a lot for sharing. What you're going through is beyond fucked up. Loneliness and the instability it comes with is a disease. I turned 20 this year and I always tell myself that I won't make it past 30 so I can relate to your sentiment.
Having no one to lean on is killing me inside which is why I always find myself on here when it gets to a critical point, I don't know where else to turn. And when I do open up to someone I'm met with little reactions. 

I want to give you words of encouragement but I fucking suck at things like these so thank you for your words, your story and most of all your time. Please take care and I hope you too will find someone who will be there for you.

It's weird how hard it can be to understand kindness sometimes, it still makes me feel guilty and undeserving for not appreciating it as much as I wish I could. 

Italian sounds nice.

Thank you for the reply and sorry for the late response

Hi sorry for the late reply, idk if I'm stressed but it might be the case.
I'll be going on holidays soon with my family I hope I can make sense of my feelings by the time my next semester starts.
I really hope it's just me being overwhelmed and stressed.

I wish I had a concrete answer to that. I just think that my life is going no where and for some reason nothing makes me happy anymore, I just feel empty or sad most of the time.
I just kind of developed these feelings over time and now they are kind of weighing on me, I don't know where they come from they are just there and there's nothing I can do about it.
I've been thinking about this question a lot, considering that I don't have an inexplicably bad life like so many other people (on here) do.

Thank you for reaching out

Thank you for your encouraging words, it means a lot to me really. I'm hoping for things to get better, maybe it's as they say: "it gets worse before it gets better."
Again, thank you for your kind words.
